title: Firearm Volume 1 #9 (May 1994, Malibu Comics) Ultraverse - James Robinson
descriptionText: The Firearm Volume 1 #9 comic book, published by Malibu Comics in May 1994, features writing by James Robinson and belongs to the Ultraverse series. This single issue is in English and follows a superhero genre, making it suitable for a general audience. With a vibrant color style and originating from the United States, this collectible item is a must-have for fans of US Comics and comic book collectors alike.
